defs.def: a piece of clothing worn on the top half of the body over a shirt, etc. that has sleeves and fastens down the front; a short, light coat 夹克衫；短上衣

ex.s: Jeremy used his jacket and an extra shirt to keep Ian warm and they rested together through the night.
ex.t: 杰里米用他的夹克和一件额外的衬衫给伊恩保暖，他们一起休息度过了那个夜晚。

ex.s: Life Behind the Lens A white-haired old man riding an ordinary bicycle around the streets of New York, always wearing the same blue worker’s jacket and simple black running shoes.
ex.t: 镜头背后的人生：一位白发老人骑着普通自行车穿行在纽约的街道上，总是穿着那件同样的蓝色工装夹克和简单的黑色跑鞋。

ex.s: Suddenly the man hears the voice again, "Your jacket is really smart." Knowing that his friend 9 (arrive) soon, the man wonders if it is her, butthereis no onehe recognises around.
ex.t: 突然，那人又听到了那个声音：你的夹克真的很帅气。那人知道他的朋友很快就要到了，他想那声音是不是她的，但周围没有他认出的人。

ex.s: While they waited for help, Jeremy gave Ian his food and water and let him lie on his jacket.
ex.t: 在等待救援的时候，杰里米把自己的食物和水给了伊恩，让他躺在自己的夹克上。

an outer cover around a hot water pipe, etc., for example to reduce loss of heat （热水管的）保温套，绝热罩
the skin of a baked potato 烤过的土豆的皮
